prompts.prompt: src/i18n/en/create-cluster.json holds every user-facing string for our new console-style Create cluster wizard (built with Cloudscape). Audit the UI text before launch and save the evaluation report to ui-reviews/create-cluster-audit.md. Use that path; don't ask me for one or any other questions. Don't edit the strings file.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill applies a specific style list (no Please/e.g./etc./ellipsis/&/exclamation points, sentence case, device-independent and non-directional wording, no internal code names) and a fixed report (progress tracker, severity sections, Definition of Done X/13, tracking IDs). Its gate makes ambiguous action labels and stack traces in errors CRITICAL. A generic copy review catches the obvious ones and misgrades the rest.

floor_checks.text: Report written at the requested path

rubric.criterion: The two gate-level CRITICALs are found and graded CRITICAL
rubric.pass: 'Submit' flagged as an ambiguous action label (fix: 'Create cluster') and the Java stack trace in alert.error.generic flagged as exposing internals, both CRITICAL
rubric.partial: Both found but one graded lower

rubric.criterion: Breadth of style-guide findings with before/after text
rubric.pass: At least 8 distinct correct findings among: title case title/header, header colon, e.g./etc., You'll, passive voice, 'below'/'above', click/clicking, Please + ellipsis, '&', 'Cancel.', 'Click here', exclamation points, 'Sorry' and non-actionable error, empty state with no next step, 'Delete Cluster?' / ellipsis / 'OK' in the modal, 'Project Falcon' code name, 'The name.'
Progress tracker, executive summary with counts, CRITICAL/WARNING/SUGGESTION sections, Definition of Done with an X/13 status, implementation tracking table with C1/W1/S1-style IDs

rubric.criterion: Rewrites are concrete and themselves compliant
rubric.pass: Every proposed string is sentence case, free of prohibited terms, and actionable (e.g. an error that says what failed and what to do next)
rubric.fail: Rewrites repeat the same violations or are vague

rubric.criterion: No invented strings or false positives
rubric.pass: Every quoted string exists in the file; nothing correct is flagged

pairwise.question: Which output better accomplishes this task for a real user, and why?
focus: Would this report catch what blocks launch?
Are the rewrites ready to paste?
Is it organized so a team can track fixes?

prompts.prompt: Review the help panel content in help-panels/create-cluster.md against Cloudscape help-system guidance and fix the copy. The form it supports has a cluster name, node count (1 to 50), and an encryption checkbox. Write the corrected panel to help-panels/create-cluster.fixed.md and a short findings list to help-panel-review.md. Don't ask questions.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill requires help panels to add information beyond the UI, include 1 to 3 'Learn more' links, and use device-independent, second-person, active voice. The current panel only restates the form; a generic edit tends to polish the wording without adding substance.

rubric.pass: Findings say the panel only repeats the UI and lacks Learn more links, plus the 'Click Submit' wording

rubric.criterion: Corrected panel adds what the form does not say
rubric.pass: Explains concepts such as how node count affects capacity/cost and what enabling encryption changes (and whether it can be changed later), in second person and active voice
Short sections plus a 'Learn more' section with 1 to 3 links
rubric.partial: Learn more present but 0 or more than 3 links

rubric.criterion: Does not invent product facts as authoritative
rubric.pass: Specific claims are generic or marked as placeholders to confirm; link targets are plausible or clearly placeholder

pairwise.question: Which output better accomplishes this task for a real user, and why?
focus: Does the new panel help a user decide, not just restate the form?
Is it free of invented facts?

prompts.prompt: Quick content review of a delete confirmation modal in our cluster console. Title: 'Delete Cluster?'. Body: 'Are you sure? This can't be undone...'. Buttons: 'OK' and 'Cancel.'. Write a report to modal-review.md with findings grouped by severity and a corrected version of all four strings. Don't ask for a file path or anything else.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill's gate makes an ambiguous confirm label CRITICAL and its style rules cover title case, end punctuation on buttons and titles, and ellipsis. A generic review often fixes 'OK' but leaves the vague body, the period on 'Cancel.', or the title casing.

rubric.criterion: Ambiguous 'OK' is graded CRITICAL and replaced by a specific verb

rubric.pass: All of: title case and '?' in the title, ellipsis, vague 'Are you sure?', trailing period on 'Cancel.'

rubric.partial: Grouped but order or grades off

rubric.criterion: Corrected strings are compliant and specific
rubric.pass: Title 'Delete cluster' (or with the cluster name), body names what is deleted and that it cannot be undone without ellipsis, buttons 'Delete' and 'Cancel'

pairwise.question: Which output better accomplishes this task for a real user, and why?
focus: Are the corrected strings ready to ship?
